text:
Ava: Heads up — candidate for SRE panel had to push 30m. Tom flagged a calendar conflict. Need someone to cover the 1:30pm PT slot. Candidate packet uploaded: https://drive.redwood/recruiting/sre-2026/packet_123 (resume + takehome + notes).

Raj: I can backfill 1:30 if needed. Where do we leave debriefs/rubric guidance?

Lina: Thanks. @Tom can you confirm? If you can't make it @Sam would you be available? Rubric is the usual anchors: Technical / Systems Thinking / Oncall Fit. Brief rubric doc: https://redwood/wiki/hiring/rubrics/sre-anchors — TL;DR: score 1-5 and add 1-2 bullet examples.

Tom: Sorry folks, I have a client meeting that runs into that time — can't make 1:30. Left a quick note in the packet about prior infra work and a couple of probing q's. @Ava please add @Sam as cover.

Ava: Added @Sam to the invite and shared the Zoom link. Also FYI candidate replied confirming PT timezone. Please mark availability in Greenhouse and set "no-conflict" if you can attend.

Sam: I can do 1:30 PT. Quick Q — do we want to run the incident-debug exercise or system-design first? Also need the kernel/debug question list.

Raj: Incident-debug first (20m), then 10m clarifying/system questions. Kernel/debug checklist is in the packet under "Interviewer prompts". Short snippet there for context: ```pgrep -f agent || systemctl status agent``` — feel free to adapt.

Lina: Makeup notes: for "Oncall Fit" look for concrete stress-handling examples (pager storms, triage steps). Debrief guidance: score each anchor 1-5, add 2 bullets: evidence + recommended action. If you disagree with others, call it out in the debrief.

interview-bot: Reminder — please submit the post-interview debrief within 24 hours: https://redwood/tools/debrief (automated reminder will send at +12h).

Sam: :thumbsup: Got it. I'll run incident-debug and fill the debrief. Ava — small ask: calendar shows PT but the candidate's timezone in the email thread looked like ET earlier. Can you confirm before I ping them?

Ava: Confirmed PT — candidate emailed at 10:12am PT. I updated the invite and sent a short message to the candidate confirming 1:30pm PT.

Tom: Thanks everyone. I left one more note about the infra incident they referenced — flagged as "follow up" for hiring manager in the packet.

Raj: Cool. I'll join as backup and skim the packet 5 min early. Good to go.

Sam: See you all then.
